title: The Autobiography of Malcolm X
author: Malcolm X
summary: Told with Alex Haley, this is Malcolm X's account of his life, from a troubled youth and prison through the Nation of Islam to his break with it and his pilgrimage to Mecca.
readIf: you want a first-person story of personal reinvention set within the civil rights era.
skipIf: you want a balanced, outside biography with multiple viewpoints.
